project.name: jboss-logging-tools Example — Translations
project.description:
Locale-specific .properties translation files for the logging-example interfaces. This JAR contains no Java sources — only .properties files co-located at the same package path as the source interfaces.
At provisioning time, pass this JAR alongside the core JAR so the runner can discover the translation files and generate the locale-specific _$logger_fr classes:
java -jar logging-provisioning-time-VERSION-runner.jar \ --output /tmp/out \ ../examples/target/logging-example-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar \ target/logging-example-translations-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar
